scope: Personally viewed all16 recently revised-entry illustrations in three labelled sheets, compared full final explanations and metadata. Separate from assigned range reviewers.

entries.observed: Tiny seed casts vastly enlarged shadow.
entries.rationale: Visual metaphor conveys exaggeration; does not falsely identify a different fruit.

entries.observed: Ornate pouch open and empty on table.
entries.rationale: All show and no substance is directly visible; age need not be pictured.

entries.observed: Paired seated friends, then one beside empty chair.
entries.rationale: Presence and absence fit the primary short saying; the longer son-in-law variant is not the only required image.

entries.observed: Man gestures expansively beside bare field and idle tool while two listen.
entries.rationale: Boastful farming claim without action fits.

entries.observed: Foreground eater with rice bowl; singers and instruments behind.
entries.rationale: Practical hunger alongside devotion fits without necessarily labelling devotion hypocrisy.

entries.observed: Entire plant and exposed roots beside empty planting hole.
entries.rationale: Fits primary root-removal expression, not a speculative literal account of related ଖୋଳ କରିବା.

entries.observed: Three people reading a book, intact stool and empty plate beside them.
entries.rationale: Contextual discussion is accurately captioned, but overeating and resulting excess are absent; weak semantic illustration rather than a direct contradiction.

adjudication.reason: Separate reviewer confirms the explicitly labelled critical discussion is compatible with the final meaning and does not introduce a wrong command or caste claim. Coordinator retains only optional recommendation to depict overeating more directly.

entries.observed: Inactive seated man beside grain mill, waiting person holding grain and another gesturing.
entries.rationale: Imagined stalled work conveys neither doing nor allowing others.

entries.observed: Four people around neem branch, milk bowl and sugar cubes.
entries.rationale: Shows literal ingredients without specifying the uncertain sugar treatment.

entries.observed: Accusatory pointing around empty box; central person raises restraining palm.
entries.rationale: Illustrates suspicion after loss and restraint against accusations.

entries.observed: Three people watch jackal eating fallen cucumbers beneath vine supports.
entries.rationale: Three responsible people and unprotected garden crop fit; trellis is an ordinary garden feature, not a mistranslation.

entries.observed: Two workers at unfinished frame look toward sparsely stocked cabinet.
entries.rationale: Shows resource shortage but no wasteful spending or spending-to-distress contrast; tied to older broad lack-of-means reading. Redesign recommended.
entries.full_size_followup: Native1536px image inspected: stocked/empty shelves, tools and unfinished frame, but no spending, purchases, money or before/after sequence.

adjudication.reason: Separate reviewer accepts an imagined depiction of the shortage consequence. It does not contradict the final meaning. Coordinator recommends a clearer spending-to-hardship contrast but does not classify omission of the first clause as a factual visual error.

entries.observed: Family meal beside open store with nearly empty grain sack.
entries.rationale: Meal and lean stores depict plenty versus scarcity without inventing snake-fare or frog story.

entries.observed: Standing man smiles, nods and gives thumbs up; seated person gestures by unfinished wall.
entries.rationale: Promised help and unfinished work fit evasive promises.

entries.observed: Striped pointed quill and lamp above two equal empty chairs.
entries.rationale: Symbolic contrast fits hurt versus light without depicting actual grandchildren as inferior.

entries.observed: Person with bundle at open doorway, chipped bowl nearby.
entries.rationale: Imagined departure/refusal fits general meaning; caption does not assign traditional speaker identity or origin.
